summary:
Use-after-free and memory corruption when application callbacks re-enter
c-ares during cancel, destroy, server reconfiguration or connection
teardown (GHSA-pj7p-v3cw-hq66, GHSA-rf6g-ww74-97qh, GHSA-97vq-4mxv-7vhm,
GHSA-v33j-65h4-4ch8, GHSA-wpr3-8q3r-4q8c, GHSA-mw23-pfg6-2x9r).
Backport of the v1.34 fix set the advisories name: 7f408deb, f944c471
(must ship with it) and 13a10ddd (additional paths, needed by
GHSA-pj7p-v3cw-hq66). 1.34.5 has no ARES_CONN_FLAG_NONEW, so the
ARES_CONN_FLAG_DEAD enum hunk is re-anchored, and 13a10ddd's
process_read() check sits before 1.34.5's `return read_answers()`.
